title: Pit Chaos Handling with Passes
description: Players inside a faceoff circle stickhandle through traffic while players around the outside move a separate puck. Rotate groups after short work intervals. Emphasize scanning, finding open ice, presenting passing targets and making the next play before the puck arrives.
coaching_points: Keep the head up and scan constantly.
Find open space while handling the puck.
Outside passers should think one play ahead.
Progress to one-touch or two-touch passing for advanced groups.

title: Puck Race to Possession Game
description: Two players race to a loose puck inside a circle. The winner protects possession under pressure. On a second whistle the puck carrier attacks the net while the defender works to recover and return possession to the coach.
coaching_points: Win the puck line with body position.
Protect the puck with hips and shoulders while keeping the feet moving.
Avoid reaching; stay in a strong skating posture.
Transition immediately from protection to attack.

title: Corner to Half Wall 2 vs 1
description: Play a 2-on-1 inside a constrained corner-to-half-wall area. The offense works to complete a set number of passes before attacking the net, while the defender wins by creating turnovers or forcing the puck out of the area.
coaching_points: Use the boards as an extra passing option.
Protect the puck until a passing lane opens.
Move immediately after passing.
Defend with active sticks, stops and starts.

title: Swedish 2 vs 1 (Cross Ice)
description: Two offensive players and one defender compete inside a small cross-ice area. The offense must connect on a prescribed number of passes before earning a shot; the defender earns an attacking chance by disrupting possession.
coaching_points: Move without the puck.
Protect first, then expose the puck to pass.
Defend with active sticks and stops and starts.
Encourage pass-and-move and give-and-go habits.

title: Gates of Buffalo Small Area Passing Game
description: Players score by passing through small gates placed around a confined area. Change the number and size of gates, available space, player count, obstacles and competitive rules to scale difficulty.
coaching_points: Play with the head up.
Move to open space after every pass.
Use verbal and non-verbal communication.
Reduce space or gate size to increase decision speed.

title: NZ Give and Go
description: Play 2-on-2 in the neutral zone with a support player on the blue line who can activate to create a temporary 3-on-2. The possession team uses movement after the pass to generate give-and-go options and new passing lanes.
coaching_points: Move immediately after passing.
Work off defenders' heels to create new lanes.
Know the next destination before moving the puck.
Look to get the puck back instead of circling the perimeter.

title: Pioneer 2 V 2 Rush
description: The drill begins with a 1-on-1 rush. On the next whistle a second rush starts the opposite way while the original pair joins, turning the sequence into a continuous 2-on-2.
coaching_points: Angle with speed while skating forward.
Defenders communicate through the transition.
Backcheck tightly and stay connected.
Recognize the shift from 1-on-1 to 2-on-2 quickly.

title: 2 v 3 Entry Offense vs. Breakout Transition
description: Start with a 2-on-2 rush plus a backchecker to create a 2-on-3. After the defending team wins possession, it immediately supports the puck and breaks out while two new attackers enter, creating the next repetition.
coaching_points: Transition immediately after possession changes.
Get two players to the puck on the breakout.
Move the puck before the opposition can organize.
Use the format to teach entries, re-entries and rush reads.

title: Buffalo 2v2 to 3v3 to 4v4
description: Begin with a 2-on-2 rush. On successive whistles add one player per team with a new puck, progressing to 3-on-3 and then 4-on-4 before resetting the repetition.
coaching_points: Attack quickly before defenders are set.
Support the puck by moving to open ice.
Backcheck with sticks on the ice and keep attackers outside.
Transition to offense immediately after regaining possession.

title: 3 on 3 Add a D
description: Play 3-on-3 on a shortened rink with one stationary support defenseman behind each team's net. A team activates its extra D by completing a pass behind the net, creating a 4-on-3 until possession changes.
coaching_points: Encourage defensemen to join the rush.
Look for weak-side speed.
Transition quickly when possession changes.
Recognize when activating the extra player creates an advantage.
